# [TASK] Frontend: dictation language switch (English/German)

## Task
Add a language switch to the frontend, wired to the speech-to-text request
and persisted across sessions.

## Scope
UI control and its wiring only — assumes #212's backend language
parameter already exists.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A visible EN/DE switch on `VoiceControl.jsx` sets the active dictation language (`VoiceControl.test.jsx`'s "defaults the dictation-language switch to English for a first-time user" test)
- [x] The selected language is sent with every `/speech-to-text` request until changed (`VoiceControl.test.jsx`: "persists a language switch and sends it with the next speech-to-text request", "keeps sending the switched language on a second request without switching again")
- [x] Selection persists across page reloads (localStorage), defaulting to English for first-time users (`dictationLanguage.test.js`: "defaults to English when nothing has been stored yet", "returns the persisted language once set", "falls back to English when the stored value is not a supported code"; `VoiceControl.test.jsx`: "restores a previously-persisted German selection on mount", "falls back to English when localStorage holds an unsupported/corrupted value")
- [x] Switching language mid-session doesn't require a page reload or break an in-progress recording (`VoiceControl.test.jsx.keeps recording uninterrupted and uses the newly-selected language when switched mid-recording`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes
A small `ToggleButtonGroup` (EN/DE) above the VoiceControl Fab, backed by `dictationLanguage.js` (`getDictationLanguage`/`setDictationLanguage`), mirroring the `getBackendTarget`/`setBackendTarget` localStorage pattern in `apiUrl.js`. Persists under `lmdb_dictation_language`, validates against `['en','de']`, defaults to `en` for a first-time or corrupted value.

`VoiceControl.jsx` reads the selection into a `languageRef` rather than raw state, so a switch made after recording starts is still picked up when the request is sent — `MediaRecorder.onstop` is bound once per recording and would otherwise close over a stale value.
